content.title: F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) Delivers Strong Q4 CY2025 Numbers, Stock Jumps 13.3%
content.summary: Application security provider F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 7.3% year on year to $822.5 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($780 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 4.7% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.45 per share was 21.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
